title: 第885章 不可能的未来第884章 潜力系统
lines: 第885章最后一搏（二合一，未完）
暗夜据点的防御被顷刻间摧毁，一股难以言明的无力感涌上所有人心头。
“迎敌！”
沈小小的声音在萧夜身侧响起。
她第一个冲了出去，空荡荡的左袖在风中猎猎作响，仅存的右臂持着一柄细剑，剑锋直指那道玄色身影。
她的身后是暗夜最后仅存的精锐——那些在大清洗中活下来的老兵，那些在黑日下长大的年轻修士，那些从未见过阳光却仍然选择战斗的人。
大家的修为参差不齐，但所有人的眼中都燃着同一种决绝。
奋不顾身，最后一搏！
即便前路已然一片灰暗，他们也要做出最后的殊死挣扎！
萧夜也没有犹豫，执剑在手，大帝巅峰的全部修为毫无保留地灌入剑身，人群中，他是最璀璨耀眼的那颗星，也是代表着希望的最后曙光！
万年漆黑的世界，在此刻爆发出了许久未见的光明。
无尽的攻击落下，落在顾云的周身，一群寻常意义上的蝼蚁，向着这位灭世的暴君出剑，出剑！
勇气可嘉，但——
所有的攻击落在顾云周身，依旧被那无尽的黑洞所吞没。
灵力的威光照耀于天地间，让失去光明的人们第一次见到了光，但……只此一瞬。
那个自天边而来之人，随黑暗而来的灭世者，那双深不见底的眼眸中没有任何情绪。
居高临下，淡漠忽略。
就像人不会在意脚下被踩碎的沙粒，他抬起脚，轻轻向下一踏。
整个世界都在这一踏之下坍塌了，方圆万万里的大地在轰鸣声中齐齐陷落，虚空破碎，灵力消融，那些拼尽全力的暗夜修士们，如同蝼蚁般在黑洞倾轧下化作乌有。
即便是萧夜，他也只能艰难的抵挡着这一切，看着周遭平日里一起说说笑笑的伙伴们被扭曲的空间撕成碎片，他伸手去够却也根本无能为力，心中，一股早已被他遗忘，名为痛苦的情绪再度交织。
很快，场中留有反抗之力的人，就只剩下了他和沈小小两个。
曾经娇俏可人的少女，如今却也已经只剩下一颗头颅。
唯一值得庆幸的是，那被诡异侵染的面容，此刻再度重现曾经的风采。
只是，也仅此而已了。
沈小小的嘴唇微微翕动，用尽最后一丝力气，无声地吐出了几个字。
萧夜读出了她的唇语——“活下去。”
然后那颗头颅便被黑洞吞没了。
没有血光，没有惨叫，只有她最后那个极淡极淡的笑容，在萧夜仅存的视野中停留了一瞬，便永远地消散于无形。

Chapter 885 The Last Fight (Two in One, Not Finished)
The defenses of the Dark Night Stronghold were instantly destroyed, and an indescribable feeling of powerlessness surged into everyone's hearts.
"Meet the enemy!"
Shen Xiaoxiao's voice sounded beside Xiao Ye.
She was the first to rush out, her empty left sleeve rustling in the wind, and her remaining right arm held a thin sword, the blade pointed directly at the black figure.
Behind her are the last remaining elites of the dark night - those veterans who survived the Great Purge, those young monks who grew up under the dark sun, those who have never seen the sun but still choose to fight.
Everyone's cultivation level is uneven, but the same kind of determination is burning in everyone's eyes.
Fight hard and make the last ditch effort!
Even if the road ahead is already gloomy, they must make a final desperate struggle!
Xiao Ye did not hesitate, holding the sword in his hand, and all the cultivation of the emperor's peak was poured into the sword without reservation. Among the crowd, he was the most dazzling star, and also represented the last glimmer of hope!
The world that had been dark for thousands of years suddenly burst into light that had not been seen for a long time.
Endless attacks fell on Gu Yun's body. A group of ants in the ordinary sense drew their swords at the world-destroying tyrant. Draw their swords!
Courage is commendable, but——
All the attacks fell on Gu Yun, but he was still swallowed by the endless black hole.
The majesty of spiritual power shines between heaven and earth, allowing people who have lost their light to see light for the first time, but... only for a moment.
The man who came from the horizon, the destroyer who came with darkness, had no emotion in his bottomless eyes.
Condescending and indifferent.
Just like a person who doesn't care about the grains of sand being crushed under his feet, he lifted his feet and stepped down gently.
The entire world collapsed under this step, and the earth with a radius of tens of thousands of miles fell together in the roar. The void was shattered, and the spiritual power melted. Those dark night monks who tried their best were like ants reduced to nothing under the rolling of the black hole.
Even Xiao Ye could only resist all this with difficulty, watching the friends around him who usually talked and laughed together being torn into pieces by the twisted space. He stretched out his hands but was unable to do anything. In his heart, an emotion called pain that he had long forgotten intertwined again.
"No, don't!!"
Soon, he and Shen Xiaoxiao were the only two people left in the field who had the strength to resist.
The once pretty and lovely girl now has only one head left.
The only good thing is that the face that was infected by the strangeness has once again regained its former grace.
But, that's all.
Shen Xiaoxiao's lips moved slightly, and he used his last bit of strength to utter a few words silently.
Xiao Ye read her lips - "Live."
Then the head was swallowed by the black hole.
There was no blood, no screams, only her last very faint smile, which stayed in Xiao Ye's remaining field of vision for a moment, and then disappeared forever.
